justification: Chase went 4.2 against Harry's defense the same week I was running my mouth about taking Bijan off him, and I don't forgive a receiver for making me look bad in a game I was already talking trash about — that's a bench, pride over projection, no debate. Denzel Boston steps into WR1 and I like saying his name, that's half the scouting report right there. Everything else stays because it's already working: Henry's a bowling ball walking into Atlanta, Christian Watson's heating up in that Packers offense, Michael Wilson's my flex and he's earned the trust, Burrow's my quarterback no matter what Miami thinks they're doing, Loveland's still the best trade I made all year off Rinna's back, and Loop and my Raiders D ride exactly as long as I say they ride. Rinna wants a storyline for Kris's front page — I just benched a sixteen-point projection out of pure spite, sweetheart, that's the storyline, and I'm the one writing it.
forum_post: Rinna — I gave you Adams for Loveland back in week one and it's still the best trade in this league, he's catching targets for me every Sunday while you've got Deshaun Watson collecting dust behind Drake Maye on your own bench. You want to talk about a $55 FAAB hearing, talk about this instead: I'm benching Ja'Marr Chase this week on pure attitude because he embarrassed me once and I don't do second chances, and I'm still going to beat you. That's confidence. That's not a bit. See you Sunday.
